description: Public Service Commission - Annual Esala Festival of Seenigama Devol Maha Devala in Hikkaduwa D/S Division, Galle District to be held from 24th to 31st August, 2017 - Amendment made to the Public Service Commission in Ex,ord. No. 2016/37 of 26.04.2017
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the schedule for the Annual Esala Festival at a specific religious site (Seenigama Sri Devol Maha Devala) under the Pilgrimages Ordinance. It does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) nor does it fit any specialized categories (4-9) as it is not about land, legal/commercial matters, elections, public service, or judicial matters. This falls under cultural/religious administrative matters, making it Miscellaneous (Type 10).
